description_en: Gets details for a specified agent, including its basic, branch, and version information
description_zh: 查询指定智能体的详细信息，包括基础信息、分支信息、版本信息等
name: QueryAiVoiceAgentDetailNew

parameters.help_en: The ID of the branch. If you do not specify this parameter, the active branch is used
parameters.help_zh: 分支 ID。为空时自动定位到当前生效分支
parameters.name: branch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the version. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the latest published version for the specified branch. You must specify BranchId when you use this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 版本 ID。为空时取对应分支的最新发布版本。需与 BranchId 配合使用
parameters.name: version_id
